required_adapters.note: A provider-neutral verifier now checks governed Aave V3 collateral and variable-debt positions, policy-pinned per-user token mapping slots, MPT account/storage proofs, reserve indexes, owner authorization, contract code hashes, Chainlink/capped-stable prices and freshness, conservative rounding, liabilities, and guest dispatch. Its public workflow constructs the deterministic checkpoint candidate, emits owner authorization, and collects every governed account and storage proof at the certified block. It reproduces the historical A666 collateral and debt values. Governed A666 policy/committee inputs, adversarial and fuzz qualification, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral successor verifier now checks an exact governed multichain native/ERC-20 position set, quorum-certified state roots and timestamps, account/storage MPT proofs, code hashes, owner authorization, decimals, omissions, duplicates, checked bounds, and guest dispatch. Its public workflow deterministically constructs each checkpoint candidate from a pinned RPC height, supports independent checkpoint voting/assembly, emits the complete owner-authorization statement, and collects the governed proof set from an exact RPC map. It reconstructs every native and ERC-20 proof in the historical A666 artifact. Prices remain a separate disclosed valuation trust dimension. The governed A666 policy/committee fixture, adversarial and fuzz qualification, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral verifier now checks the HyperEVM reader receipt, BFT-certified header, owner authorization, complete policy-pinned spot set, positions, holds, values, liabilities, bounds, and guest dispatch, with historical receipt reconstruction. The hardened HyperCore receipt-reader contract and its canonical position-set checks now live in the public repository. Public deployment and receipt-proof collection, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral verifier now checks certified-head, outcome, block, reader, pool, implicit-account ownership, quantity, bounds, and guest dispatch, with historical Merkle reconstruction. Valuation remains separately attested by design. Public collection, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral verifier now checks a governed exact stake-account set, derived addresses, stake/withdraw/vote authorities, stake activation/deactivation state, lamports, finalized-slot snapshot agreement, bounded data, owner authorization, independent signer policy, signatures, and guest dispatch. It reconstructs the historical A666 stake quantities and honestly labels that evidence attested. This is an interim historical/diagnostic scaffold, not the production successor: a public finalized source-state verification and collection mechanism that does not trust an operator or RPC signature for the quantity is required. That mechanism, fuzzing, fresh epochs, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.

A provider-neutral cryptographic quantity verifier now checks Monero transaction decoding and hashes, tx public keys, shared-secret ownership proofs, key-image ring signatures, subaddress spend-key proofs, RingCT amount recovery and commitments, transaction inclusion, block-header anchoring, BFT-certified head and key-image spent status, bounded inputs, exact NAV/profile/manifest/policy/epoch context, and guest dispatch. It cryptographically reconstructs the historical nonzero A666 fixture and verifies a context-bound zero-reserve proof without an aggregate amount attestation. Public collection, a fresh governed nonzero proof with a certified head chain/status set, separate XMR/USD valuation evidence, fuzzing, full A666 reconciliation, and production qualification remain open.
